description: This file contains unit tests for the EverynetProvider class in the org.eclipse.hono.adapter.lora.providers package. It verifies extraction of device ID, payload, and message type from LoRaWAN messages.

classes.name: EverynetProviderTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the EverynetProvider, verifying message processing methods.

methods.name: extractDeviceIdFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Test that device ID is correctly extracted from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractPayloadFromLoraMessage
methods.description: Test that payload data is correctly extracted from a LoRa message.

methods.name: extractTypeFromLoraUplinkMessage
methods.description: Verify that the message type 'UPLINK' is correctly identified.

methods.name: extractTypeFromLoraUnknownMessage
methods.description: Verify that an unknown message type defaults to UNKNOWN.
